items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: The interviewee does not mention One Eyed B; the name is introduced solely by the interviewer.

ctx.x: But they played music the same... Well, they played music the same... Yeah, they played the same night. They played the same night. Yeah. And the band was playing. And the one that meant by the name of band, the band was one that just played. This player. This player. So all the band, you know what I think I qualified music, things like that. We used to get in with this drum. This drum. You know, that big, that big black top. The young boys and the bass, you just go for soup. Yeah. Well, his band won that…
Yeah, I know them. One Eyed B. Yeah, One Eyed B.

Well, if it was played against another band, they would have to play. And that's another band. Everybody would have to go all around to see her. Right. Night big. And played at that night. Sweet Mary. Sweet, sweet, what they call this? Or again, they call her sweet, um, Al. Another one. She's very old. The Albuyer? Uh huh. That's on the North Street. Yeah. Sweet Alma. Sweet Alma, yeah. Sweet Alma, yeah. That was their band. Yeah. And they on the pro band. But the other band, that was supposed to be so strong, was…
